manifest.name: intro_state
manifest.text: Welcome to Praman Desk, the autonomous pre-payment spend firewall for AI agents and DAOs on Telegraph Protocol. Operating live on Devnode Miner sixty-one twenty-seven, bonded on Sepolia Diamond sixty-one forty-two with eighteen active tools.

manifest.name: two_minds_scen_7
manifest.text: Here is Scenario Seven: the Two-Mind spend guard on hellominds dot ai. An agent attempts a ten thousand five hundred dollar payout with an inverted exchange rate. The firewall reconciles the transaction in our six-hundred-fifty-one byte WebAssembly engine, catches the thirteen hundred seventy-three dollar discrepancy, and halts execution before signing.

manifest.name: sanctions_and_payout
manifest.text: Scenario One screens counterparty addresses against US Treasury OFAC records, catching a Lazarus Group match in three milliseconds. Scenario Three clears a compliant payout to Anthropic, validating legal entity identifiers in GLEIF and authorizing instant settlement.

manifest.name: ledger_closing
manifest.text: Every verified transaction commits to our immutable Sepolia Diamond ledger. Fifty-seven on-chain receipts are published with verifiable Etherscan transaction hashes. Praman Desk prevents catastrophic capital loss before any wallet signs.
